WF_T0, WF_DT and WF_N are drawn by prereg.schedule(): lo + sha256(tag || name) mod (hi - lo + 1) within the extreme rows; the WF_T0 extremes start at the registration day (2026-11-13T00:00:00Z), so every walked block is out of sample
block k = the first Base block with timestamp >= WF_T0 + k * WF_DT (prereg.first_block_at); a target past the head is absent and the walk stops there
the hard rule has no tolerance: netOut <= balance delta, exact (src/BlazePhoenixQuoter.sol:436-440, R-C)

column3: the gap between delivered and netOut + safetyBuffer on the fork is logged, not asserted: the owner decides it
the WF_T0, WF_DT and WF_N extremes are the registrant's defaults; the owner may replace them before the first result (then reseal and update the test)
